g.title: DRAVET_QSP
g.text: Dravet Syndrome (SCN1A Developmental & Epileptic Encephalopathy) — Mechanistic QSP Map
SCN1A haploinsufficiency → Nav1.1 loss in GABAergic interneurons → threshold failure of fast-spiking inhibition → E:I imbalance → seizures, status epilepticus, developmental arrest, SUDEP
Blue = gene/channel · Green = cell & network physiology · Red = seizure/injury · Orange = drug & PK · Pink = enzymology/DDI · Purple = receptor target · Grey = clinical endpoint · Yellow = toxicity
